primitive_box_note: Primitive gcd(c)=1 fractions are enumerated exactly in the robustness atlas; no separate primitive asymptotic density theorem is claimed.

proof: Subtracting gives DeltaE_c=c dot (A_K(S')-A_K(S))=c dot DeltaA.
If DeltaA!=0, choose an index j with DeltaA_j!=0. For every assignment of the other k-1 coordinates, the equation c dot DeltaA=0 determines at most one value of c_j.
Hence the number N_B(DeltaA) of neutral vectors in C_B is at most (B+1)^(k-1). Removing the all-zero vector and enforcing 0<=c_j<=B can only decrease the count.
Therefore N_B(DeltaA)/((B+1)^k-1) <= (B+1)^(k-1)/((B+1)^k-1), which tends to 0 as B tends to infinity.
This is a finite integer counting argument; no continuum measure is used.
theorems.statement: For a fixed elementary move S->S' with DeltaA!=0, shared-linear scalar neutrality is equivalent to c dot DeltaA=0. In C_B={c in Z_nonnegative^k:0<=c_j<=B,c!=0}, the neutral vectors form a proper exact integer kernel slice.

proof: Substitute DeltaA=0 into DeltaE_c=c dot DeltaA.
theorems.statement: If DeltaA=0, then DeltaE_c=0 for every shared linear coefficient vector c.

proof: Forgetting labeled-pair positions maps an equal R3 table to an equal pair-spectrum multiset.
Summing every spectrum coordinate over an equal multiset gives equal aggregate vector A_K.
Applying any shared linear functional c to equal A_K gives equal E_c.
theorems.statement: R3 equality implies R2 equality, R2 equality implies R1 equality, and R1 equality implies R0 neutrality for every shared linear coefficient vector.
